summary: Armata Pharmaceuticals filed Form 8-K disclosing entry into a $25 million secured term loan facility with Innoviva Strategic Opportunities LLC, a subsidiary of principal shareholder Innoviva, Inc. The loan carries a 14.0% annual interest rate, matures January 11, 2029, and is secured by substantially all of the company's assets, with subsidiary guarantees. The agreement includes customary covenants and events of default. While a material definitive agreement, this financing does not constitute a classic special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or going-private transaction. It is more akin to a debt financing arrangement. The press release also announced Q1 2026 financial results. No deal terms such as price per share or premium were applicable. The filing is routine debt financing, not a special situation.
